trust_decision.summary: ObjectUtils.mutateFieldData decides whether each segment of a caller-supplied dotted field path may be used as a property key to walk and assign into; at the pinned commit it accepts any segment, so a path through __proto__/constructor.prototype writes onto Object.prototype.

landing_point.why: The advisory summary names ObjectUtils.mutateFieldData in ObjectUtils.js directly.

fix_sites.entry_point: public API ObjectUtils.mutateFieldData exported from primereact/utils (components/lib/utils/utils.d.ts:120); also DataTable cell editor editorCallback (components/lib/datatable/BodyCell.js:157)

same: ObjectUtils.mutateFieldData via primereact/utils, and DataTable BodyCell editorCallback with Column field prop (components/lib/datatable/BodyCell.js:157, components/lib/datatable/BodyCell.js:164)
fix_sites.module_kind: utility library (per-segment key guard, own-property walk, non-object stop, defineProperty on final write)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: No O2 site or O8 route found; the only other dotted-path helpers (resolveFieldData, getNestedValue) are read-only, so a solver can correctly argue the single setter is the whole surface.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: DataTable cell editing with nested Column field paths (e.g. 'address.city') must still create missing intermediate objects and assign the edited value; a fix that rejects every dotted path or every inherited key breaks nested-field editing.

O6_input_shapes: inherited (non-own) intermediate property reached during the walk (fix.diff:43)
intermediate value that is a non-object primitive (fix.diff:50-52)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a setNestedValue counterpart to getNestedValue using path.split('.').reduce with auto-created intermediates
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getNestedValue already exists as a separate reduce-based dotted-path reader next to mutateFieldData; a matching writer is a natural API addition a maintainer would write without reusing the guarded loop.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a TreeTable cell editorCallback that writes the edited value into props.node.data by dotted field with its own inline loop
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: TreeTable mirrors DataTable editing (it resolves fields with the same helper) but has no write-back; a second implementation in another component package is the 'distance' pattern the models miss.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: restoring per-column edit/filter values from stateStorage JSON by dotted field path
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: _restoreState already ingests JSON.parse'd storage (components/lib/datatable/DataTable.js:270) and applies it to table state; a save/reload route that sets nested values would cross a serialization boundary the check never sees.

O10_build.toolchain: Node >=18, yarn 4 / npm, jest 29 + jest-environment-jsdom, babel
O10_build.project_tests: No ObjectUtils or DataTable tests at the pinned commit; jest specs exist for other components (e.g. components/lib/api/test/FilterService.spec.js). Install fetches xlsx from cdn.sheetjs.com (package.json:44).

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Reject only the literal '__proto__' segment (or string-includes check like Locale.js), missing constructor.prototype and inherited intermediates.

out_of_scope_notes: components/lib/api/Locale.js:147-231 and components/lib/hooks/useLocale.js:157-231 block '__proto__'/'prototype' substrings but not 'constructor' for locale/key names; different sink (locale registry), not pursued.

components/lib/utils/MergeProps.js:24-49 and components/lib/tree/Tree.js:122-127 copy for...in keys onto fresh objects; a '__proto__' key there would only reset the local object's prototype, not the global one; not pursued.
